issues.title: Promotion is not gated on measured evidence
Test-count badge is hand-typed and already wrong (39 vs 58)
write_gate.py --file crashes instead of blocking
rules/zones.json points at a zone that does not exist (`02_Index`)
No durable repository memory — HANDOFF is transient by design
Agent contract is single-host and the installer still points at Obsidian
Loop report candidates are untyped free text with no count identity
README/START/HANDOFF quote numbers a fresh clone cannot reproduce
Candidate evidence can cite gitignored local state, so CI is the first reader to fail
Registry is create-only, and the declared supersedes rule is not enforced
A markdown-layout record is created invisible: news and wiki_note escape every gate
Two contracts claim one file: the note gate judges a registry record as a broken note
state_fingerprint counts gitignored, regenerated `15_SYSTEM/generated/` -- an `index` run ages every probe and no clone can reproduce a base
issues.note: ۱۵_SYSTEM/generated از هویت حذف شد؛ ایشیو در گیت‌هاب باز است.
